linesVerbatim: ## Monorepo CI and independent component releases
**Proposed V2 architecture requirement.** OpenSIP may remain a monorepo while
components release independently. Declared component ownership and dependency
metadata select isolated language/component CI lanes; an unrelated change does
not force every language closure to build. The selector must fail safe when
ownership or dependency impact is ambiguous.
Each selected component lane builds, tests, packages, signs, attests, emits an
SBOM/license inventory, and qualifies its self-contained closure on the relevant
manifest-declared platforms. It also runs its language-native capability/parity,
behavior, performance, runtime-UX, packaging-adapter, and conformance gates.
Separate lanes cover:
- the shared distribution core/semantic host/pure-core contracts;
- common control protocol and unchanged opaque provider data planes;
- semantic-authority and D9/fate integration;
- deterministic lock/dependency/compatibility resolution;
- clean-machine authoritative offline closure; and
- aggregate convenience/air-gap bundle qualification.
Independent releases do not require separate repositories and do not create
lockstep versions. A release selects independently qualified compatible bytes
through signed metadata and per-surface matrices.
DR-121 and DR-G16 require acceptance tests for correct lane selection, omitted
dependency/owner detection, per-lane exact release evidence, and cross-component
integration. CI provider, YAML, repository path filters, caches, commands, and
implementation tooling remain reserved for the later blueprint.

governingSources.role: Source pin: Monorepo CI and independent component releases.
D-002 (slice-affecting; G16 required; authoritative offline closure out of slice 1).

selector.inputs: Declared component ownership and dependency metadata (manifest + index custody). Not path-filter heuristics as authority.
selector.rule: Ownership and dependency metadata select isolated language/component CI lanes. An unrelated change does not force every language closure to build.
selector.failSafe: When ownership or dependency impact is ambiguous, the selector MUST fail safe: it selects the wider set (including shared lanes that the ambiguity touches) rather than omitting a dependent lane. Fail-safe is over-selection, never under-selection.
selector.mustNot: Path filters, CI vendor config, or cache keys cannot be the authority that decides impact. Those are reserved implementation.

must: qualify the self-contained closure on the relevant manifest-declared platforms
run language-native capability/parity, behavior, performance, runtime-UX, packaging-adapter, and conformance gates
componentLane.platforms: Relevant platforms are those declared in the component manifest. D-002 vocabulary for slice 1. Windows absent until that platform enters.

sharedLanes.name: shared distribution core/semantic host/pure-core contracts
sharedLanes.note: Required whenever those contracts change or the selector is ambiguous about them.

sharedLanes.name: common control protocol and unchanged opaque provider data planes
sharedLanes.note: Consumes DR-102. Does not translate provider frames.

sharedLanes.name: semantic-authority and D9/fate integration
sharedLanes.note: Does not mint D9 codes. Executes against the applied D9 surface.

sharedLanes.name: deterministic lock/dependency/compatibility resolution
sharedLanes.note: Consumes DR-103/DR-107/DR-111. Window evaluation waits on DR-111.

sharedLanes.name: clean-machine authoritative offline closure
sharedLanes.note: NAMED. Not required for architecture preview. D-002 defers authoritative sealed closure (DR-106/109/113 wholly). The lane is not deleted from the architecture.

sharedLanes.name: aggregate convenience/air-gap bundle qualification
sharedLanes.note: A bundle may qualify a selection; it cannot be the only route (DR-127). Preview does not require the bundle lane to ship.

rules: Independent releases do not require separate repositories.
Independent releases do not create lockstep versions.
A release selects independently qualified compatible bytes through signed metadata and per-surface matrices.
independentRelease.evidence: Per-lane exact release evidence: the emission of that lane (manifest/tree/declarations/conformance report or core inventory) plus the selector decision record that included or excluded it.

classes.name: correct lane selection
classes.requires: A change touching only component A selects A's lane and does not force unrelated language closures.

classes.name: omitted dependency detection
classes.requires: A change that affects B through a declared dependency, with B omitted from the selector input, fails safe (selects B) or refuses as ambiguous. Silent omit is a failed successor.

classes.name: omitted owner detection
classes.requires: A change whose owner metadata is missing or conflicting fails safe or refuses. It does not default to no-op.

classes.name: per-lane exact release evidence
classes.requires: Each selected lane emits the independent-release evidence object.

classes.name: cross-component integration
classes.requires: Shared lanes SL-2/SL-3/SL-4 run when the selector includes more than one component or a protocol/lock/authority surface.

g16Tests.execution: Condition 4. Existing here does not QUALIFY.

dependencies.consequence: Component-lane package/sign/attest/SBOM steps consume DR-120. This artifact does not redesign them.
Independent release selection uses matrices; it does not evaluate windows this row does not own.
The lane runs those gates; numbers are not decided here.
SL-6 cannot become the only release route.

whatThisDoesNotDo: Does not SATISFY DR-121 until independently reviewed and recorded by a later D-000 MF-6.
Does not choose a CI vendor, YAML, path filter, cache, or command.
Does not execute DR-G16 or mark QUALIFIED.
Does not delete the authoritative-offline lane from the architecture; it marks it preview-unrequired.
Does not require separate repositories or lockstep versions.
